Selected experiences

Two-day workshop · NY Empire Academy

Lead & Influence: Negotiation and Communication Workshop

I completed the two-day Essentials Workshop, practising public speaking and negotiation through exercises and simulations.

I worked on making a point clearly, then listening for what the other person needed before deciding where there was room to negotiate.

Read more about Lead & Influence: Negotiation and Communication Workshop

Volunteering · Al-Rowad International Schools · May 2025

Graduation ceremony volunteering

I helped set up the ceremony, seat guests and support backstage logistics as a student volunteer.

I worked alongside staff and other students before guests arrived and during the ceremony. Moving between the guest area and backstage showed me how much a smooth event depends on clear handovers and good timing.
